statements: New consumer keys generated in-container (python secrets) and transferred only via docker exec stdin pipes; never in host argv, env, files, logs, evidence, or git.
No API response bodies containing secrets were printed (provider/consumer reads performed with redacted extraction).
Evidence records only: change facts, value counts, revoked/active booleans, HTTP codes, latencies.
Old values revoked from the console after the new keys were verified working end-to-end.
